Subject: Consolidating an intro/demo across our infra & apps

Hi Jonas, Ben, Irene —

Thanks for the quick replies in our initial outreach. We’re coordinating a short group demo for three internal teams at CloudBridge (Platform, Data Services, and App Integrations). Goal: a single 45–60 minute session that covers routing/region logic, burst capacity behavior, and a quick Q&A on integration patterns.

A few constraints on our side:
- We have folks in PST (SF), CST (Dallas), and CET (remote EU). Best overlap window is 10:00–13:00 PT / 19:00–22:00 CET.
- Expected attendee count: up to 28 across teams (some observers).
- Procurement will want a short slide on capacity/SLAs if we go to pilot. (I’ve attached a short usage summary.)

Questions:
1) Can Redwood host a multi-team demo that uses one bridge (Zoom/Meet) without losing per-account context?
2) If we hit 25+ active participants, do you recommend splitting into parallel rooms or a time-sliced approach?
3) Can you share a tentative schedule and a registration link so I can coordinate internally?

If it helps, I can supply a single calendar invite and a protected attendee list.

Thanks —
Mike Torres
CloudBridge, Director of Integrations
Attachment: initial-usage.pdf
From: Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.com>

Subject: Re: Consolidating an intro/demo across our infra & apps

Hi Mike — great context, thanks. Short answers up front: yes, and we have two recommended patterns depending on your priorities.

Pattern A — Single bridge, structured host flow (recommended if you want cross-team Q&A):
- 60-minute single session
- Host flow: 15m product overview (Jonas), 15m architecture+deployment patterns (Irene), 15m live demo showing routing/fallbacks + KV cache behavior (Ben), 15m Q&A.
- We’ll use per-account demo prompts and we can switch model variants live so each team sees their surface-area.
- Accepts up to ~30 attendees (we’ll use polling + raised-hand moderation).

Pattern B — Parallel breakout rooms (recommended if hands-on or very specific configs):
- Three 25-minute concurrent rooms + a 15-minute wrap. Requires 3 hosts.

A couple operational notes:
- For predictable throughput visibility we recommend enabling a short prefix cache demo and a small batch of requests from each team so we can demonstrate tail-latency behavior.
- If procurement needs SLA slides, I’ll attach a short one-pager; we can also open a separate procurement call.

Proposed slots (PT):
- Wed Apr 14, 11:00–12:00 PT
- Thu Apr 15, 12:00–13:00 PT

Registration/ops: https://redwood.zoom.us/meetings/registry?event=multi-team-demo-20270414 (this is a simple RSVP page + waitlist). HubSpot record: https://hubspot.redwood.com/contacts/DBL-2027-1137

Irene and Ben — can you confirm if you prefer to host the architecture/demo segments (Irene: infra/route; Ben: live demo + metrics)? Also, Ben — if we expect >25 active presenters, are your team’s hosts available to split?

— Jonas
